summary: Iteration 72: CidadeCombobox Component Testing - ALL TESTS PASSED. Verified the new Popover + Command (cmdk) based city dropdown component across multiple pages. The CidadeCombobox successfully replaces the old Select-based city dropdowns with a searchable combobox that filters cities as the user types.

pre_existing_issues.issue: Hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> - pre-existing React hydration issue
Chart width/height warnings when container not visible - cosmetic only
Missing Description or aria-describedby warning - accessibility improvement needed
WebSocket connection closed before established - intermittent connection issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: CidadeCombobox component fully functional across all tested pages. Uses Popover + Command (cmdk) pattern with search input placeholder 'Buscar cidade...'. Cities are fetched from IBGE API. Component supports allOption prop for 'Todas' option in filters.
